mapper.insert: insert into pet_ai_conversation (conv_no, user_id, user_name, scene, intent, biz_id, title, store_id, message_count, last_time, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{convNo}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{scene}, #{intent}, #{bizId}, #{title}, #{storeId}, 0, sysdate(), '0', sysdate(), sysdate())

insert into pet_ai_message (conv_id, role, content, blocks_json, citations_json, actions_json, tool_names, latency_ms, create_time) values (#{convId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{blocksJson}, #{citationsJson}, #{actionsJson}, #{toolNames}, #{latencyMs}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select * from pet_ai_message where conv_id = #{convId} order by msg_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into pet_ai_feedback (conv_id, msg_id, user_id, rating, reason, create_time) values (#{convId}, #{msgId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{reason}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select m.conv_id as convId, date_format(m.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as createTime, (select u.content from pet_ai_message u where u.conv_id = m.conv_id and u.role = 'user' and u.msg_id < m.msg_id order by u.msg_id desc limit 1) as question from pet_ai_message m where m.role = 'assistant' and m.content like '%没有查到可靠%' order by m.msg_id desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) as total, coalesce(sum(case when rating = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as good, coalesce(sum(case when rating = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as bad from pet_ai_feedback
select coalesce(intent, 'unknown') as intent, count(*) as total from pet_ai_conversation group by coalesce(intent, 'unknown') order by total desc

select count(*) as total, coalesce(sum(case when date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as today, coalesce(sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as handoff from pet_ai_conversation
